accessibility.text: After jumping over your opponent's checker, their piece is removed from the board.
Jump over your opponent's checker, landing in an empty space just behind it.
After your turn, your opponent takes their turn following the same rules.

After the first game, the winner of the previous game typically goes first in subsequent games.
Only your own checker pieces are eligible for moving & Move precisely one space diagonally.
Check for more jumping opportunities to continue your turn, allowing consecutive jumps.
Move your checker diagonally to an empty adjacent space.
Players roll a dice to decide the first move.
